components.text: Curses a White Oak Ash Dagger into a Cursed one. Only the Cursed Dagger lodges in an Original hybrid as well as an Original; the plain one no longer does. Needs the dagger, 2 white oak ash and an echo shard.
Anyone can work it. A witch, a siphoner or a tribrid knows it from the start; the book keeps it sealed for the rest. It makes an item and acts on nobody, so there is no one to ask for consent.
Both daggers hurt a supernatural wielder alike, and a dagger that finds nothing to lodge in does not say why, so a miss never tells you what someone is.
